name: Measures for the Labeling of AI-Generated and Synthetic Content
description: Requires 'explicit' (visible text/audio/graphic) and 'implicit' (embedded metadata) labeling of AI-generated/synthetic content — text, image, audio, video, virtual scenes — by internet information service providers and content-distribution platforms. Paired with mandatory national standard GB 45438-2025 (Cybersecurity Technology — Labeling Method for Content Generated by Artificial Intelligence). Jointly issued by CAC, MPS, SAMR, and NRTA (National Radio and Television Administration).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn).
